## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive (mixed breadth). Confirmations: VXX (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -5.73%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND (fear easing) and Stocks vs Bonds SPY/TLT (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +7.94%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND; reflation signal CPER (1W: +7.15% | 1M: +7.41%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND adds confirmation.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress edging higher: HYG (1W: -0.01% | 1M: -0.24%) → flat | BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -0.88%) → flat | BELOW TREND show tightening HYG/LQD. Macro tailwinds: SPY (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +6.89%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and VXX complacency support risk appetite.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar strength firming: Dollar (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +0.91%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Yield curve flattening: Yield Curve (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -1.12%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND with TLT (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -1.84%) → flat | BELOW TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +19.43%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Energy providing breadth: XLE (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +4.14%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Financials showing weakness: Financials (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -2.61%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND — Style: Growth over Value.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforming: SPY (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +6.89%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +12.93%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. EM/China mixed: EEM (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +8.33%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND while China (FXI 1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.98%) → flat | ABOVE TREND but China vs US metrics ↓ falling | BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation present but cooling: IBIT (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +8.48%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +5.59%) → flat | ABOVE TREND, while the Speculation Index (1W: -2.81% | 1M: -5.42%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodities-led reflation: CPER (1W: +7.15% | 1M: +7.41%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +4.73% | 1M: +18.79%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND, while GLD (1W: -1.04% | 1M: -3.01%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND shows gold underperformance.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy broadening: XLE (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +4.14%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +5.48%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND — energy is a constructive cyclical driver.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech (XLK 1W & 1M positive) and QQQ (1W & 1M positive) show trend confirmation; VXX (1W & 1M negative) confirms fading fear. DIVERGENCE: Breadth narrow at 5/11 with Consumer Discretionary/XLY in CORRECTION (1W: -1.01% | 1M: +0.41%) — minor-to-moderate divergence, monitor consumer cyclicals and credit.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to tech and cyclical commodities: XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +19.43%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +7.15% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND showing strength; reduce exposure to defensive buckets: Utilities XLU (1W: -0.49% | 1M: -2.43%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and GLD BELOW TREND. Monitor HYG/LQD for signs risk appetite rolls over.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology — XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +19.43%) ABOVE TREND if QQQ follow-through continues. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary — XLY (1W: -1.01% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION if retail/consumer cycle data softens.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/Industrial metals — CPER (1W: +7.15% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND on reflation momentum. BEARISH: Gold — GLD (1W: -1.04% | 1M: -3.01%) BELOW TREND if real yields stay elevated.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), SPY/TLT 8.81 (stocks vs bonds momentum), Tech vs Financials 3.50 (leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive (mixed breadth). XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +19.43%) and QQQ (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +12.93%) showing strength alongside commodities CPER (1W: +7.15% | 1M: +7.41%) and BNO (1W: +4.73% | 1M: +18.79%). Key risk is narrow breadth and rising credit stress — monitor HYG (1W: -0.01% | 1M: -0.24%) and the consumer/cyclical divergence (XLY CORRECTION 1W: -1.01% | 1M: +0.41%).
